newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Paccar completes takeover of DAF Trucks.
newsitem.headline: Paccar completes takeover of DAF Trucks.

text.p: U.S. truck-maker Paccar Inc. has completed its friendly 933 million guilder ($552.5 million) takeover of DAF Trucks NV by acquiring 100 percent of the shares, the Dutch company said Friday.
The deal consolidates Paccar's position as the world's third biggest producer of heavy trucks with annual sales of $6.3 billion.
Paccar, which is based in Bellevue, wash., makes Peterbilt and Kenworth trucks and in Europe it has now added DAF to its Foden trucks business in Britain.
Paccar said last month it expected DAF immediately to make a positive contribution to earnings, adding that its cost structure was among the lowest in Europe.
Paccar and DAF announced the friendly takeover bid Oct. 7, setting the seal on DAF's recovery following the bankruptcy of the old DAF NV in February 1993.
